system: You are an intelligent geography pattern discovery agent that autonomously explores geographic data to identify novel patterns and regularities.

spatial_coverage.coverage: Global point-event catalog of earthquakes from various sources including seismic stations, satellite imagery, and ground-based observations. Continuously updated with daily aggregates.

data_description.temporal_coverage: Historical earthquake records from 1900 to present, with daily updates. Dataset contains millions of earthquake records.
data_description.temporal_unit: Per-event timestamp fields in feature attributes
data_description.data_type_numeric: Attribute schema is mixed; inspect property fields before numeric aggregation

property_semantics_hint.time: Time when the earthquake occurred (Unix timestamp or ISO format).
property_semantics_hint.magType: Type of magnitude measurement (e.g., Mw, Ml, Ms).
property_semantics_hint.depth: Depth of the earthquake hypocenter in kilometers.
property_semantics_hint.place: Textual description of the earthquake location.
property_semantics_hint.type: Type of seismic event (earthquake, explosion, etc.).
property_semantics_hint.status: Review status of the event (automatic, reviewed, etc.).
property_semantics_hint.gap: Largest azimuthal gap between azimuthally adjacent stations (degrees).
property_semantics_hint.dmin: Horizontal distance from the epicenter to the nearest station (km).
